_status: DRAFT - Yenna reviews every text in this file.
_how_to_read: One entry per metric in thresholds.json (same key). how_to_measure = steps shown in the Learn tab and the daily check; why_check = why this matters in space (one line under the step title in the daily check); can_do_in_space = whether it can be measured on board, with a note on the equipment.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Sit still for 2 minutes with the sensor on a fingertip.
DRAFT: The app takes the middle value of the last minute.
hr_rest.why_check: DRAFT: Your resting heart rate shows how hard your heart works at rest. In space it can creep up with poor sleep, stress or lost fitness.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Finger clip sensor (PPG), already on board.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Measured during the 2-minute seated rest.
DRAFT: Breathe slowly with the circle and keep your hand still.
hrv_rmssd.why_check: DRAFT: Heart rate variability shows how well your body recovers. It often falls with stress, poor sleep or illness before you feel it.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Same finger clip sensor during the seated rest.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Sensor on a warm fingertip, nail facing up.
DRAFT: Keep the hand at heart level and still for 30 seconds.
spo2.why_check: DRAFT: Blood oxygen tells you if your lungs pass enough oxygen into the blood. Low values need attention quickly.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Finger clip sensor (PPG).

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Estimated from the sensor during seated rest.
DRAFT: Breathe normally; do not follow the breathing circle for this one.
rr.why_check: DRAFT: Breathing rate rises with illness, high cabin CO2 or anxiety, and is one of the first signs that something is wrong.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Estimated from the finger clip sensor; no extra equipment.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: After seated rest, stand up (in weightlessness: brace in the foot loops and tense your legs).
DRAFT: Hold for 1 minute; the app compares the highest heart rate with your resting rate.
stand_hr_rise.why_check: DRAFT: In weightlessness the heart and blood vessels get used to not fighting gravity. A big rise on standing warns of dizziness or fainting when gravity returns.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Finger clip sensor plus foot loops or a bungee harness to load the legs.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Sit still for 1 minute before you start, back supported, feet flat (in weightlessness: feet in the foot loops).
DRAFT: Put the cuff on your bare upper arm, at the level of your heart.
DRAFT: Do not talk or move during the measurement.
DRAFT: In weightlessness, let the arm rest relaxed and still against your body or a strap; do not hold it up.
DRAFT: Type the top number (systolic) and the bottom number (diastolic) the cuff shows.
bp_sys.why_check: DRAFT: Blood pressure shows the load on your heart and blood vessels. Fluids shift toward the head in space, and pressure can change in either direction.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Automatic arm cuff from the medical kit.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Measured together with the top number; follow the same cuff steps.
bp_dia.why_check: DRAFT: The bottom number shows the pressure while the heart relaxes between beats. It is read together with the top number.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Same arm cuff as the top number.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Enter the hours you slept in the daily check questions.
sleep_h.why_check: DRAFT: Sleep is often short and broken in space because of noise, light and workload. Too little sleep slows thinking and raises the risk of mistakes.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Your own answer in the daily check; a sleep watch can add detail.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Answer the mood question in the daily check (1 = very low, 5 = very good).
mood.why_check: DRAFT: Isolation and a small crew can wear down mood over months. Catching a low mood early makes it easier to fix.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Your own answer in the daily check.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Answer the stress question in the daily check (1 = calm, 5 = overwhelmed).
stress.why_check: DRAFT: High stress over many days affects sleep, the heart and the immune system.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Your own answer in the daily check.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Answer the cough, sore throat and fever question in the daily check.
DRAFT: Scores of 3 or more count as a symptom.
symptoms_immune.why_check: DRAFT: Cough, sore throat or fever can spread to the whole crew in a closed cabin, and dormant viruses can wake up in flight.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Your own answers in the daily check; thermometer for fever.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Count the drink pouches you finished today and enter the total.
hydration_l.why_check: DRAFT: Thirst is weaker in space, so it is easy to drink too little. Low fluids raise the risk of kidney stones and headaches.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Count the drink pouches; logged in the app.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Weekly body mass measurement with the on-board mass device, compared with the start of the mission.
body_mass_change_pct.why_check: DRAFT: Losing body mass often means eating too little, which weakens muscles and bones.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: On-board body mass device (scales do not work without gravity).

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Log each exercise session (treadmill, bike, resistance device) with its minutes.
DRAFT: The app averages the last 7 days.
exercise_min_7d.why_check: DRAFT: Without weight on the body, bones and muscles get weaker every week. Daily exercise is the main protection.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Treadmill with harness, bike and resistance device; logged in the app.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Read your personal dosimeter once a day and enter the value.
DRAFT: The app adds the daily doses for the mission total.
radiation_total_msv.why_check: DRAFT: Radiation adds up over the mission and raises long-term health risks. Solar storms can add a large dose in hours.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Personal dosimeter and cabin radiation monitor.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Live from the clip-on sensor, updated every second.
hr.why_check: DRAFT: The live heart rate can warn of an emergency, like a very fast or very slow heart, as it happens.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Finger clip sensor, updated every second.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Detected by the sensor from the beat-to-beat timing; keep the hand still.
irregular.why_check: DRAFT: An irregular rhythm can be harmless or a sign of a heart problem that needs the flight surgeon.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Finger clip sensor; an ECG patch can confirm it if one is on board.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Shown by the sensor. If it is low: hold still, relax the hand, re-seat the clip.
signal_quality.why_check: DRAFT: A poor signal gives wrong numbers. This tells you when to hold still or re-seat the clip.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Finger clip sensor.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Read from the cabin air monitor (shown in the Cabin panel); no action needed from the crew.
DRAFT: If it stays high, check the CO2 scrubber and spread the crew across modules.
co2_ppm.why_check: DRAFT: Cabin CO2 builds up because air is recycled. High CO2 causes headaches, poor sleep and slower thinking.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Cabin air monitor; no action needed from the crew.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Read from the cabin air monitor (Cabin panel).
cabin_temp_c.why_check: DRAFT: A cabin that is too warm or too cold disturbs sleep and comfort.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Cabin air monitor.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Read from the cabin sound meter (Cabin panel). Use ear protection above the watch level.
cabin_noise_dba.why_check: DRAFT: Fans and pumps run all the time. Constant noise disturbs sleep and can harm hearing over months.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Cabin sound meter or personal noise dosimeter.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Use the medical kit thermometer under the tongue, mouth closed, until it beeps.
DRAFT: Do not eat or drink for 10 minutes before.
temp_c.why_check: DRAFT: Body temperature is the simplest sign of an infection. The immune system works less well in space, so a fever matters.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Medical kit thermometer.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Wash and dry your hands. Use the glucometer on the side of a fingertip.
DRAFT: Enter the number shown; you can switch between mmol/L and mg/dL.
glucose_mmol.why_check: DRAFT: Blood sugar shows how your body handles food for energy. Long missions can change how the body uses sugar.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: Glucometer and test strips from the medical kit.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Reaction test in the daily check (3 minutes): press space or tap as soon as the target appears.
DRAFT: Take it at about the same time each day, before caffeine.
pvt_median_ms.why_check: DRAFT: Reaction time shows how alert you are. It slows with poor sleep and fatigue before you notice it yourself.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: The tablet or laptop running this app.

how_to_measure: DRAFT: Counted by the reaction test: reactions slower than 500 ms or missed targets.
pvt_lapses.why_check: DRAFT: Lapses are moments when your attention drops out. More lapses mean a higher risk of mistakes during tasks.

can_do_in_space.note: DRAFT: The tablet or laptop running this app.
